item.title: Kumano Kodo Iseji: The Pilgrimage Route Through Mie — Guide
item.description: The Kumano Kodo is a network of ancient pilgrimage routes across the Kii Peninsula, registered as a UNESCO World Heritage site, and its Iseji route is the one that runs through Mie — linking the great shrine of Ise with the sacred Kumano region down the prefecture’s rugged southern coast. Walked by pilgrims for over a thousand years, the Iseji climbs a series of atmospheric mountain passes paved with moss-covered cobblestones, threading through towering cedar forest between glimpses of the Pacific.
